thread.title: SPY, CROC: Big ETF Outflows

author: BNK Invest
title: SPY, CROC: Big ETF Outflows
text:
Shutterstock photo Looking at units outstanding versus one week prior within the universe of ETFs covered at ETF Channel, the biggest outflow was seen in the SPDR S&P 500 ETF ( SPY ), where 7,850,000 units were destroyed, or a 0.8% decrease week over week. Among the largest underlying components of SPY, in morning trading today Apple ( AAPL ) is up about 0.1%, and Microsoft ( MSFT ) is higher by about 0.2%.
And on a percentage change basis, the ETF with the biggest outflow was the ProShares UltraShort Australian Dollar ( CROC ), which lost 50,000 of its units, representing a 33.3% decline in outstanding units compared to the week prior.
